summary: The submission presents a well‑documented, preregistered paired confirmatory run comparing a GVR pipeline with a frozen single‑pass LLM using a deterministic synthetic benchmark and validator. Execution and analysis appear to follow the preregistration and are reproducible from the archived artifacts; the null/ceiling outcome is correctly explained. However one required reproducibility disclosure from the prior terminal review remains unresolved: the manuscript does not include the exact discordant pair identifier and a precise archive locator for the single repair provider trace (the lone repair-stage hosted_model_call record) needed for deterministic auditor verification.
critical_issues: Missing explicit identifier and precise locator for the single discordant episode / repair provider trace. The archival bundle contains execution/raw_results.jsonl (SHA‑256 = 0d841d29dd190ebe50a1973b0eabfd8801bf81476d395b417145fb5201a5511d) and the execution_manifest/deterministic_reconciliation artifacts referenced in the paper, but the manuscript does not copy the exact pair_id value nor a concrete JSON record index or provider‑trace artifact SHA that would let an auditor deterministically locate the lone repair record and verify the discordant pair.
required_revisions: Insert the exact discordant episode identifier (pair_id) copied verbatim from the archived provider trace into the manuscript (Results section and Disclosure Statement). Do not invent or paraphrase the identifier—use exactly the string present in execution/raw_results.jsonl.

Insert a precise archive locator for the single repair provider trace into the manuscript: either (A) the provider‑trace artifact path plus its SHA‑256 and a JSON record index/byte offset (e.g., execution/raw_results.jsonl SHA‑256 = 0d841d29... and JSON record index N where record.stage == "repair"), or (B) the provider‑trace file path and the provider‑trace record's own SHA‑256 (if per‑record SHA is present in the archive). Also cite the execution_manifest and/or deterministic_reconciliation.json entry that cross‑references this record so auditors can map the repair record to the pair_id and to analysis artifacts. All of these values must be copied verbatim from the archived artifacts (e.g., execution/raw_results.jsonl and execution/execution_manifest.json) and placed in the Results or Disclosure text; no new analysis or experiments are required to supply them.
optional_revisions: If space permits, include one short sentence summarizing the validator diagnostics for the discordant episode (copied directly from the archived validator_trace) to illustrate what the repair changed.
Condense long provenance/hash lists into a compact single paragraph or footnote to improve narrative flow while retaining all required references to archived artifact paths and SHA‑256 values.
Optionally compute and report the preregistered effect‑size equivalent (Cohen‑h for paired proportions) or explicitly state why that computation was omitted; archive the result if computed.
